sentences.text: Present appeal is filed by the insurance company challenging the liability saddled on the insurance company to pay compensation.
2. Factum of accident, claimant sustaining injuries are not disputed.
The only disputed fact is that whether the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation or not.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
4.

In the present case, it is the case of the claimant that the claimant and others have travelled in the goods auto rickshaw from Savanur to Alipura and the driver of the auto rickshaw drove the same in rash and negligent manner and auto rickshaw turned turtle due to which claimant has suffered injuries and filed a claim petition.
The tribunal while awarding compensation has saddled the burden on the insurance company to pay compensation.

In the present case, the complainant is brother of the claimant who has stated that himself,
claimant and other three to four persons have travelled from Savanur to Alipura.
After completion of their market at Savanur and while returning, the accident was occurred.
Ex.P1 is the complaint and FIR.

Ex.P2 is a written statement which is given by the complainant by changing the version that the claimant after purchasing fertilizers at Savanur market and while returning to Alipura with the said fertilizer bags met with accident.
The written statement given is found to be a after thought version.
In the spot mahazar after lodging the complaint there is no mentioning that fertilizer bags have fallen on the land.

When it is the case of the claimant that auto rickshaw was turtled/capsized then the commodity in the auto rickshaw must have been fallen on the ground and if fertilizer bags have fallen on the ground, the same should have been noted in the spot panchanama.
But in the spot panchnama, fertilizer bags were not found on the ground.

But, in the written statement, it is The Divisional Manager vs Hanumantappa S/O Veerappa Naregal on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170822680/
2 revealed that the claimant was returning NC: 2023:KHC-D:12483 to village after loading fertilizer bags on the auto rickshaw.

sentences.text: Upon considering the evidence in this regard on all it's preponderance of probabilities, the written statement given appeared to be after thought just to put burden on the insurance company so as to show that the claimant had travelled with fertilizer bags.

Therefore,
after considering all this eventualities on all it's preponderance of probabilities it is found that there attempt is made to show that claimant had travelled along with goods.
Therefore, in this regard, it is proved that by giving written statement there is a deliberate attempt was made.
Otherwise, the claimant has travelled as gratuitous passenger in the goods auto rickshaw.
Therefore, upon considering all these evidence on records, it is proved that the claimant has travelled in the goods auto rickshaw as unauthorized passenger in the goods auto rickshaw.
Therefore, the insurance company is not liable to pay the compensation and indemnify the owner.
In this regard, the judgment is liable to be modified.
In the present case, the driver of the offending three wheeler Katama vehicle bearing No.KA-27/6239 was not having driving license to drive the same.
Therefore, the Insurance Company is exonerated from paying compensation to the claimant.

However, as per Sub- section (2)
of Section 149 of Motor Vehicle Act, when the Insurance Company established the fact that driver was not holding driving license, then as per Sub-sections (1), (5), (7) of Section 149 of Motor Vehicle Act, the Insurance Company as if the judgment debtor shall satisfy the claim in respect of third parties and then recover the same from owner of the offending vehicle.

Accordingly, order of pay and recovery is made as per the principle of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the cases of Pappu and others vs. Vinod Kumar Lamba and another1 and also as per the full bench decision of this Court in the case (2018) 3 SCC 208 NC: 2023:KHC-D:12483 of New India Assurance Co. Ltd., Bijapur vs. Yallavva w/o. Yamanappa Dharanakeri.2

sentences.text: Thus, an order of pay and recovery is made.
To this extent, the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal is modified.
7. Since, the respondent No.2 is owner of the goods auto rickshaw is liable to pay compensation.
However, as discussed above, the insurance company shall pay compensation at first instance and then recover the same from the owner of the auto rickshaw that is respondent No.2.
The respondent No.2 owner shall furnish security to the court or to the appellant-insurance company.

8. The insurance company is given liberty to file execution petition before the concerned jurisdictional execution court and seek adjudication of property either movable or immovable or both till recovery of the amount.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) Appeal filed by the insurance company is allowed in part.

sentences.text: The common judgment and award dated 21.08.2013 passed in MVC No.99/2010 by the AMACT, Hangal, stands modified, holding that the insurance company is exonerated from payment of compensation.
However, the appellant-insurance company shall pay compensation at the first instance to the claimant and then recover it from the owner of offending vehicle.

iii) The insurance company is at liberty to file execution petition before the jurisdictional executing Court as against the owner of offending three wheeler Katama vehicle bearing No.KA-27/6239 and may seek attachment of NC:
